measured_interpretation: Exact embeddings, final norm, and uniformly selected source blocks are insufficient: removing the intervening source blocks breaks the learned six-block computation and causes near-total autonomous collapse. Tokenizer and tensor compatibility alone do not make raw depth truncation a valid English transfer.
decision: Reject the raw initialization and preserve it as nondeployable negative evidence. Do not try alternate layer subsets. The jointly measured failures of raw block dropping and output-only distillation isolate the missing mechanism as learned depth compression of intermediate representations; test that once on GPU with the fixed 1-3-5 mapping.
